podcast.title: "White bread" Pop Figure (1958-1964)
podcast.body: Fabian is mentioned as one of the "white bread" pop figures, along with Frankie Avalon, who are often used to generally sum up the musically "undocumented" period of rock and roll history from 1958 through 1964. "But the period from 1958 through 1964 is generally summed up by and there were some white red nun entities like Fabian and Frankie Avalon."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 89: "Will You Love Me Tomorrow?" by the Shirelles

podcast.title: Tour Replacement (1959)
podcast.body: Fabian, along with Frankie Avalon and Jimmy Clanton, replaced Buddy Holly, Richie Valens, and The Big Bopper on the Winter Dance Party tour after the fatal plane crash. "After that date, Holly, Valens and the Bopper were replaced by Fabian, Frankie Avalon, and Jimmy Clanton, and the tour continued."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 74: "It Doesn't Matter Any More" by Buddy Holly
